36 Computational analysis Software installation NOTE: All the steps related to the computational analysis of SMF data will depend on external software. Steps 93, 94, 97, 99 and 100 require bash command line usage. Steps 95, 96 and 98 involve code in R. 93. To install Trimmomatic, navigate to http://www.usadellab.org/cms/?page=trimmomatic and download the binary for the version of your choice. Uncompress Trimmomatic-0.xx.zip and move the resulting folder to a location of your choice. No further action is required for installation. 94. To install Picard, navigate to https://broadinstitute.github.io/picard/, uncompress the .zip file and move the .jar file to a location of your choice. No further action is required for installation. 95. Read alignment and downstream analysis will depend on the Biostrings-based genome data package for the species of interest. This can be installed as indicated in the relevant Bioconductor webpage and exemplified below for Mus musculus: if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager") BiocManager::install("BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10") 96. Analysis of single molecule footprinting data can be performed using the SingleMoleculeFootprinting R package, which can be installed as follows remotes::install_github( repo = "https://github.com/Krebslabrep/SingleMoleculeFootprinting.git", ref = "main", build_vignettes = FALSE) Raw data processing 97. Read trimming can be performed using Trimmomatic as exemplified by the following command line: java -jar /installation_path/Trimmomatic-0.36/trimmomatic-0.36.jar \ PE \ -threads 5 \ Sample_Name_R1.fq.gz Sample_Name_R2.fq.gz \ Sample_Name_forward_paired.fq.gz \ Sample_Name_forward_unpaired.fq.gz \ Sample_Name_reverse_paired.fq.gz \ Sample_Name_reverse_unpaired.fq.gz \

steps.title: Select methyltransferase(s)
steps.instruction: Choose GpC methyltransferase McviPI alone or together with CpG methyltransferase SssI based on cell type: use both only if the cells lack endogenous CpG methylation (e.g., Drosophila cell lines or DNMT‑TKO mouse ESCs); otherwise use GpC only, accepting ~2‑fold fewer analysable sites.

steps.title: Isolate nuclei
steps.instruction: Perform all steps on ice or at 4 °C unless otherwise noted.

substeps.instruction: Trypsinise actively growing cells and wash once with cold PBS.
Resuspend 0.25 × 10⁶ cells in 1 mL ice‑cold lysis buffer; incubate on ice 5–10 min, inverting tubes occasionally.
Centrifuge 5 min at 1000 × g, 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Wash nuclei with 250 µL ice‑cold wash buffer; centrifuge 5 min at 1000 × g, 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend nuclei in 94.5 µL 1× M.GpC buffer; keep on ice.

steps.title: GpC methyltransferase treatment
steps.instruction: Add methyltransferase mix quickly to avoid time‑induced bias and incubate at 37 °C in two rounds.

substeps.instruction: Add 150 µL GpC methyltransferase mix to the 94.5 µL nuclei suspension.
Add 50 µL M.cviPI; mix with a P200 pipette (no vortex).
Incubate 37 °C for 7.5 min (keep samples at RT for subsequent additions).
Add 25 µL M.cviPI and 4 µL SAM; mix with a P200 pipette (no vortex).
Incubate 37 °C for another 7.5 min.

steps.title: Optional CpG methyltransferase treatment
steps.instruction: If cells lack endogenous CpG methylation, perform SssI treatment in a single addition.

substeps.instruction: Add 3.5 µL 1 M MgCl₂, 15 µL SssI, and 4 µL SAM (keep at RT).
Incubate 37 °C for 7.5 min.

steps.title: Stop reaction and proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Terminate methyltransferase activity and digest proteins overnight.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µL pre‑warmed stop solution and 6 µL proteinase K; vortex briefly.
Incubate at 55 °C overnight (samples may be frozen after this step).

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform DNA extraction
steps.instruction: Extract DNA using PCI, chloroform, and isopropanol precipitation.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 µL phenol‑chloroform‑isoamyl alcohol (PCI); shake 15× and centrifuge 5 min at max speed.
Transfer aqueous phase to a new 1.5 mL SafeLock tube.
Add 600 µL chloroform; shake 15× and centrifuge 5 min at max speed.
Transfer aqueous phase to a new tube.
Add 600 µL isopropanol and 1 µL glycogen; incubate RT shaking 10 min.
Centrifuge 20 min at max speed; discard supernatant.
Wash pellet with ice‑cold 70 % ethanol; centrifuge 15 min at 4 °C, max speed.
Remove all supernatant, air‑dry pellet, then resuspend in 20 µL H₂O (amplicon) or 30 µL H₂O (target enrichment).
Add 1 µL RNase A; incubate 37 °C 30 min.
Allow pellet to dissolve fully 2 h at 37 °C or overnight at 4 °C (samples may be frozen).
Quantify DNA with Qubit HS assay and assess purity with Nanodrop (expect ~1 µg per reaction).

steps.title: Fragment DNA for whole‑genome library
steps.instruction: Shear 3 µg DNA to ~300 bp fragments using Covaris S2.

substeps.instruction: Dilute DNA to 130 µL (3 µg in 130 µL).
Sonicate with duty factor 10 %, intensity 4, 200 cycles/burst for 100 s.
Check fragment size on Agilent Bioanalyzer (1 µL of 1:5 diluted sample).

steps.title: End‑repair of fragmented DNA
steps.instruction: Prepare and add end‑repair master mix, then incubate.

substeps.instruction: Prepare master mix per reaction: 10 µL 10× End Repair Buffer, 1.6 µL dNTP mix, 2 µL Klenow, 2.2 µL T4 PNK, 1 µL T4 DNA Polymerase (total 52 µL). Keep on ice.
Concentrate fragmented DNA to 83.2 µL with a vacuum concentrator (30 °C, 20 min).
Add the 52 µL end‑repair master mix; vortex briefly, spin down.
Thermal cycler program: 20 °C 30 min → hold 4 °C.

steps.title: AMPure bead cleanup after end‑repair
steps.instruction: Purify end‑repaired DNA using 1.8× AMPure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 180 µL AMPure XP beads to 100 µL end‑repaired sample; mix 10×.
Incubate 5 min RT; place on magnetic stand ~5 min until clear.
Remove supernatant, wash beads twice with 200 µL freshly prepared 80 % EtOH (EtOH ≤48 h old).
Air‑dry beads 1–3 min (avoid over‑drying).
Resuspend beads in 44 µL water; incubate 2 min.
Place on magnetic stand 2 min; transfer 42 µL eluate to a new tube.
Set aside 1 µL (4× diluted) for Bioanalyzer QC (run later with ligated sample).

steps.title: A‑tailing of end‑repaired DNA
steps.instruction: Prepare A‑tailing master mix on ice and add to purified DNA.

substeps.instruction: Prepare A‑tailing master mix as described in the kit (keep on ice).
Add master mix to the 42 µL eluate; vortex briefly.
Thermal cycler program: 20 °C 15 min → hold 4 °C.

steps.title: Adapter ligation (implicit in kit)
steps.instruction: Ligate adapters according to the SureSelect XT Mouse Methyl‑Seq kit (details omitted in source).

steps.title: Post‑ligation bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Clean ligated library with 0.65× AMPure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 32.5 µL AMPure XP beads to 50 µL ligated sample; mix.
Perform bead‑wash steps 38‑48 as previously described.
Elute with 24 µL water; transfer 22 µL eluate to a new tube.
Check library size on Bioanalyzer DNA HS chip (expect 430–630 bp) and quantify with Qubit HS (need 350 ng; expect 500–800 ng from 3 µg input).
Freeze if needed.

steps.title: Hybridization and bait capture
steps.instruction: Hybridize library to mouse capture baits (16 h) and capture with streptavidin beads.

substeps.instruction: Concentrate 22 µL ligated library to 3.4 µL with vacuum concentrator; keep a 3.4 µL water control.
Add 5.6 µL blocking mix; mix gently.
Hybridize 16 h at 65 °C (thermal cycler).
During 15 min incubation, prepare fresh 0.1 M NaOH (20 µL per sample).
After hybridization, bind library to streptavidin beads, wash twice with pre‑warmed 65 °C Wash Buffer 2 (200 µL each, 10 min at 65 °C).
Elute captured DNA with 20 µL 0.1 M NaOH; vortex 5 s, incubate RT 20 min.

steps.title: Bisulfite conversion of captured library
steps.instruction: Convert captured DNA using Zymo EZ DNA Methylation‑Gold Kit.

substeps.instruction: Reconstitute CT conversion reagent: 900 µL nuclease‑free water, 300 µL M‑Dilution Buffer, 50 µL M‑Dissolving Buffer (one vial per 10 samples).
Vortex 10 min RT; add 130 µL CT reagent to 20 µL captured library; vortex briefly, spin.
Split reaction into two 75 µL tubes; run thermal cycler: 64 °C 2.5 h → hold 4 °C.
Combine the two 75 µL reactions to 150 µL total.

steps.title: Post‑bisulfite cleanup and desulphonation
steps.instruction: Purify bisulfite‑converted DNA using Zymo‑Spin IC columns.

substeps.instruction: Load 150 µL combined reaction onto column pre‑loaded with 600 µL M‑Binding Buffer; spin 1 min at 17,000 × g.
Wash with 100 µL M‑Wash Buffer; spin 1 min at 17,000 × g.
Add 200 µL M‑Desulphonation Buffer; incubate RT 20 min; spin 1 min.
Wash twice with 200 µL M‑Wash Buffer; spin each time 1 min at 17,000 × g.
Air‑dry column 1–3 min; add 10 µL M‑Elution Buffer, incubate RT 3 min, spin 1 min.
Repeat elution with another 10 µL M‑Elution Buffer; combine eluates.

steps.title: PCR amplification of bisulfite library
steps.instruction: Amplify converted library with SureSelect Methyl‑Seq PCR reagents.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 82 µL PCR master mix per reaction: 30 µL nuclease‑free water, 50 µL SureSelect Methyl‑Seq PCR Master Mix, 1 µL Methyl‑Seq PCR1 Primer F, 1 µL Primer R.
Add 82 µL master mix to 18 µL bisulfite‑converted library; vortex briefly.
Thermal cycler program: 95 °C 2 min; 8 cycles of 95 °C 30 s → 60 °C 30 s → 72 °C 30 s; 72 °C 7 min; hold 4 °C.
Clean up PCR product with 1.8× AMPure XP beads (180 µL beads to 100 µL sample); follow bead‑wash steps 38‑48.
Elute in 22 µL water; transfer 19.5 µL to a new tube.

steps.title: Library indexing PCR
steps.instruction: Add indexing primers and amplify.

substeps.instruction: Prepare indexing PCR master mix per reaction: 25 µL SureSelect Methyl‑Seq PCR Master Mix, 0.5 µL SureSelect Methyl‑Seq Indexing Primer Common (total 25.5 µL).
Add 25.5 µL indexing master mix to 19.5 µL amplified library; add 5 µL selected indexing primer.
Thermal cycler program (manufacturer’s recommended cycles, typically 8–12): 95 °C 30 s; 60 °C 30 s; 72 °C 30 s per cycle; final extension 72 °C 5 min; hold 4 °C.

steps.title: Final library QC and sequencing
steps.instruction: Assess final library and submit for Illumina sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Quantify library with Qubit HS; check size on Agilent Bioanalyzer DNA 1000 chip (expect 300–600 bp).
Sequence on Illumina platform (e.g., MiSeq 250 bp PE or NextSeq 550 for whole‑genome; aim for >200 × 10⁶ reads for deep coverage).

steps.title: Amplicon primer preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare 96‑well primer plates for bisulfite amplicon PCR.

substeps.instruction: Dilute stock primers (100 µM) to 2 µM in RNase‑free water (200 µL total per plate).
Store working plates at 4 °C; stock plates at –20 °C.

steps.title: Amplicon PCR (bisulfite converted DNA)
steps.instruction: Amplify 96 targets in parallel using KAPA HiFi Uracil+ ReadyMix.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 5 µL of each primer pair from working plate into a new 96‑well PCR plate.
Add 11 µL PCR master mix per well (130 µL water, 880 µL 2× KAPA HiFi Uracil+ ReadyMix, 200 µL bisulfite‑converted DNA).
Thermal cycler program: 95 °C 3 min; 35 cycles of 98 °C 20 s → 56 °C 30 s → 72 °C 1 min; 72 °C 5 min; hold 4 °C.
Run 5 µL of each reaction on 2 % TBE agarose gel to verify 300–500 bp amplicons.

steps.title: Pool amplicons and bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Combine PCR products and purify with AMPure XP beads.

substeps.instruction: Pool 10 µL from each successful reaction (≈800 µL total).
Add 0.8× AMPure XP beads (640 µL); mix 10×.
Incubate 5 min RT; place on magnetic stand until clear.
Wash beads twice with 200 µL freshly prepared 80 % EtOH; air‑dry 1–3 min.
Resuspend beads in 52 µL water; incubate 2 min; place on magnetic stand.
Transfer 50 µL eluate to a new tube; freeze if not proceeding immediately.

steps.title: Amplicon library preparation (NEBNext)
steps.instruction: Convert pooled amplicons into Illumina‑compatible libraries using NEBNext DNA Ultra II kit.

substeps.instruction: Quantify pooled amplicons (Qubit HS); use up to 1 µg in 50 µL as input.
End‑repair: add 10 µL end‑repair master mix (3 µL End Prep Enzyme Mix + 7 µL End Prep Reaction Buffer) to 50 µL DNA; incubate 20 °C 30 min, then 65 °C 30 min, hold 4 °C.
Proceed with NEBNext ligation, adapter addition, and cleanup as per kit (details omitted).
Perform a 2 min magnetic bead cleanup (0.9× AMPure XP beads) and elute in 0.1 X TE.

steps.title: Final amplicon library QC and sequencing
steps.instruction: Check library quality and sequence.

substeps.instruction: Assess size on Bioanalyzer DNA 1000 chip; quantify with Qubit HS.
Sequence on Illumina platform (e.g., MiSeq 250 bp PE).

steps.title: Read alignment (computational)
steps.instruction: Align bisulfite‑converted reads to the reference genome using QuasR.

substeps.instruction: Load libraries in R: library(QuasR); library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10).
Run qAlign with parameters: genome="BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10", aligner="Rbowtie", paired="fr", bisulfite="undir", alignmentParameter="-e 70 -X 1000 -k 2 --best -strata".

steps.title: Merge technical replicates (optional)
steps.instruction: Combine BAM files with Picard.

substeps.instruction: java -Xmx4g -jar picard.jar MergeSamFiles I=Replicate1.bam I=Replicate2.bam O=Merged.bam

steps.title: Deduplicate reads (genome‑wide only)
steps.instruction: Mark and remove PCR duplicates using Picard (skip for amplicon data).

substeps.instruction: java -Xmx4g -jar picard.jar MarkDuplicates INPUT=Merged.bam OUTPUT=Merged_deduplicated.bam

steps.title: Generate methylation matrices
steps.instruction: Use SingleMoleculeFootprinting functions to obtain average methylation and single‑molecule binary matrices.

substeps.instruction: CallContextMethylation() to compute average methylation per cytosine.
The function returns a GRanges object (average methylation) and a matrix (binary methylation per molecule).

steps.title: Sort reads by occupancy patterns
steps.instruction: Classify molecules according to TF‑binding bins.

substeps.instruction: For a single TF: SortReadsBySingleTF(MethSM, TFBS).
For TF clusters: SortReadsByTFCluster(MethSM, TFBSs).

steps.title: Visualize SMF data
steps.instruction: Create bulk and single‑molecule plots.

substeps.instruction: PlotAvgSMF(MethGR, range, TFBSs) for average footprint.
PlotSM(MethSM, range, SortedReads) for single‑molecule stacks.
StateQuantificationPlot(SortedReads) for occupancy state frequencies.
PlotSingleSiteSMF(ContextMethylation, sample, range, SortedReads, TFBSs, saveAs) for combined view.
